1) Endorsement language: the requested phrasing "Primary and Non-Contributory; Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference" is acceptable. If CommerceCloud can obtain a carrier endorsement with that exact wording, Procurement will be able to proceed without additional review.

2) Subcontractor disclosure: we need EdgeServe listed on the COI or a subcontractor exhibit that names EdgeServe and confirms they maintain equivalent coverage. 3) Limits: verify that the policy limits meet the SOW requirements (see section 2.1 of the SOW). If limits are lower we’ll need an escalation path (contractual cap + risk acceptance).

Action: Lisa — if you can ask your broker to push an endorsement pdf with the language above and either list EdgeServe on the COI or provide a subcontractor COI, we can hand this to Procurement.
